title: Weak Password Policy
description: Password policy allows weak or easily guessable credentials.
remediation: Enforce minimum password complexity, length and password reuse restrictions.

title: Default Administrative Credentials
description: A system is configured with default administrative credentials.
remediation: Replace all default credentials and enforce unique strong passwords.

title: Missing Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Privileged accounts can authenticate using only a password.
remediation: Enable multi-factor authentication for privileged and sensitive accounts.

title: Excessive Login Attempts
description: The authentication service does not sufficiently restrict repeated login attempts.
remediation: Implement rate limiting and temporary account lockout controls.

title: Insecure Session Timeout
description: User sessions remain active for an excessive period of inactivity.
remediation: Configure appropriate idle and absolute session expiration times.

title: Broken Access Control
description: Users can access resources outside their assigned authorization level.
remediation: Enforce authorization checks on every protected server-side resource.

title: Excessive User Privileges
description: User accounts have more privileges than required for their responsibilities.
remediation: Apply least privilege and periodically review account permissions.

title: Missing Role Validation
description: Application endpoints do not consistently verify user roles.
remediation: Add server-side role validation to all privileged operations.

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
description: Resource identifiers can be manipulated to access unauthorized information.
remediation: Verify resource ownership and authorization on every request.

title: Unrestricted Administrative Interface
description: Administrative functionality is exposed without sufficient network restrictions.
remediation: Restrict administrative interfaces to trusted networks and authorized users.

title: SQL Injection
description: User-controlled input can alter database queries.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate all untrusted input.

title: Database Account Overprivileged
description: Application database accounts have unnecessary administrative permissions.
remediation: Grant only the minimum database permissions required by the application.

title: Database Accessible from Public Network
description: A database service is directly reachable from untrusted networks.
remediation: Restrict database access using private networking and firewall rules.

title: Unencrypted Database Connection
description: Database traffic is transmitted without transport encryption.
remediation: Require TLS for all database client and server connections.

title: Database Backup Exposed
description: Database backup files are accessible without sufficient protection.
remediation: Encrypt backups and restrict storage access using least privilege.

title: Cross-Site Scripting
description: User-controlled content can execute scripts in another user's browser.
remediation: Encode output and sanitize untrusted content before rendering it.

title: Cross-Site Request Forgery
description: Sensitive actions can be triggered without verifying request authenticity.
remediation: Implement CSRF protections and secure SameSite cookie settings.

title: Unrestricted File Upload
description: The application accepts potentially dangerous file uploads.
remediation: Validate file signatures, extensions and size and store files securely.

title: Directory Listing Enabled
description: The web server exposes directory contents to unauthenticated users.
remediation: Disable directory listing and restrict access to sensitive directories.

title: Sensitive Information in Error Messages
description: Application errors expose internal implementation or system information.
remediation: Return generic client errors and keep detailed errors only in server logs.

title: Missing Security Headers
description: Web responses lack important browser security headers.
remediation: Configure CSP, HSTS, frame protection and other appropriate security headers.

title: Insecure CORS Configuration
description: Cross-origin requests are permitted from untrusted origins.
remediation: Restrict allowed origins, methods and headers to trusted applications.

title: HTTP Traffic Allowed
description: The service permits unencrypted HTTP connections.
remediation: Redirect all traffic to HTTPS and disable insecure HTTP access where possible.

title: Weak TLS Configuration
description: The service supports obsolete or insecure TLS configurations.
remediation: Disable deprecated protocols and weak cipher suites.

title: Expired TLS Certificate
description: A production service uses an expired digital certificate.
remediation: Renew the certificate and implement certificate expiration monitoring.

title: Self-Signed Certificate in Production
description: A production service uses an untrusted self-signed certificate.
remediation: Replace it with a certificate issued by an approved certificate authority.

title: Weak Cryptographic Algorithm
description: Sensitive information is protected using an obsolete cryptographic algorithm.
remediation: Migrate to currently recommended cryptographic algorithms and key sizes.

title: Hardcoded Cryptographic Key
description: A cryptographic key is embedded directly in application source code.
remediation: Store secrets in a dedicated secrets manager and rotate the exposed key.

title: Unencrypted Sensitive Data
description: Sensitive information is stored without encryption.
remediation: Encrypt sensitive data at rest using appropriate key management.

title: Insecure Random Number Generation
description: Security-sensitive values are generated using a predictable random source.
remediation: Use a cryptographically secure random number generator.

title: Open Administrative Port
description: A management service is reachable from networks that do not require access.
remediation: Restrict the management port using firewall rules and network segmentation.

title: Unnecessary Network Service
description: The device exposes a network service that is not required for business operations.
remediation: Disable unnecessary services and close unused network ports.

title: Insecure Remote Management Protocol
description: A device permits administration using an insecure network protocol.
remediation: Replace insecure management protocols with encrypted alternatives such as SSH.

title: Network Segmentation Failure
description: Sensitive infrastructure is insufficiently isolated from general user networks.
remediation: Implement network segmentation and enforce traffic controls between zones.

title: Firewall Rule Too Permissive
description: A firewall rule permits a broader range of traffic than necessary.
remediation: Restrict source, destination, port and protocol according to least privilege.

title: SNMP Community String Exposed
description: A network device uses an insecure or predictable SNMP community string.
remediation: Use SNMPv3 and replace default or weak community strings.

title: Wireless Network Uses Weak Encryption
description: A wireless network permits an outdated encryption standard.
remediation: Configure WPA2-AES or WPA3 and disable obsolete wireless security protocols.

title: DNS Recursion Exposed
description: A DNS server allows unrestricted recursive queries from external networks.
remediation: Restrict recursive DNS queries to authorized internal clients.

title: Missing Network Access Control
description: Unauthorized devices can connect to internal network segments.
remediation: Implement network access control and device authentication.

title: Insecure VPN Configuration
description: The remote access VPN uses weak authentication or cryptographic settings.
remediation: Enforce strong encryption, MFA and secure VPN authentication policies.

title: Unpatched Operating System
description: The operating system is missing security updates for known vulnerabilities.
remediation: Apply current vendor security patches and establish a regular patching process.

title: Unsupported Operating System
description: The asset runs an operating system that no longer receives security updates.
remediation: Migrate the system to a currently supported operating system version.

title: Unnecessary Privileged Service
description: A system service runs with higher privileges than required.
remediation: Configure the service to run with the minimum permissions necessary.

title: Insecure File Permissions
description: Sensitive system files can be modified or read by unauthorized users.
remediation: Restrict filesystem permissions according to least privilege.

title: Root Login Enabled
description: Direct remote authentication using the root account is permitted.
remediation: Disable direct root login and require privileged elevation through controlled accounts.

title: Audit Logging Disabled
description: The operating system does not record sufficient security-relevant activity.
remediation: Enable system audit logging and forward important events to centralized monitoring.

title: Host Firewall Disabled
description: The local operating system firewall is disabled or inadequately configured.
remediation: Enable the host firewall and allow only required inbound and outbound traffic.

title: World-Writable System Directory
description: A system directory allows modifications by unprivileged users.
remediation: Remove unnecessary write permissions and review directory ownership.

title: Insecure Scheduled Task
description: A scheduled system task executes scripts or binaries from an insecure location.
remediation: Restrict task permissions and ensure executed files cannot be modified by unauthorized users.

title: Exposed System Information
description: System configuration reveals unnecessary operating system and version information.
remediation: Reduce exposed system banners and unnecessary version information.

title: Outdated Application Dependency
description: An application uses a dependency with known security weaknesses.
remediation: Update the affected dependency to a supported and secure version.

title: Dependency with Known Exploit
description: A third-party package has a publicly available exploit.
remediation: Upgrade or replace the vulnerable dependency immediately.

title: Unsupported Software Library
description: A software library is no longer maintained by its vendor or community.
remediation: Replace the unsupported library with an actively maintained alternative.

title: Unpinned Dependency Version
description: Application dependencies are installed without fixed or controlled versions.
remediation: Pin dependency versions and maintain an approved lock file.

title: Unverified Third-Party Package
description: A dependency is retrieved without validating its integrity or origin.
remediation: Verify package integrity and use trusted package repositories.

title: Dependency Vulnerability Scanning Disabled
description: The development pipeline does not scan third-party dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
remediation: Integrate automated software composition analysis into the development pipeline.

title: Abandoned JavaScript Package
description: The application relies on an abandoned third-party JavaScript package.
remediation: Replace the abandoned package with a maintained and reviewed alternative.

title: Transitive Dependency Vulnerability
description: A vulnerable package is indirectly introduced through another dependency.
remediation: Update the parent dependency or override the vulnerable transitive package.

title: Development Dependency in Production
description: A development-only package with unnecessary functionality is deployed in production.
remediation: Exclude development dependencies from production builds.

title: Package Integrity Check Missing
description: The deployment process does not verify package checksums or signatures.
remediation: Verify package signatures or cryptographic checksums during deployment.

title: Debug Mode Enabled
description: Debug functionality is enabled in a production environment.
remediation: Disable debug mode and detailed diagnostic output in production.

title: Verbose Error Logging
description: Sensitive information may be recorded in application or system logs.
remediation: Remove secrets and personal information from logs and implement log filtering.

title: Default Service Configuration
description: A service remains configured with insecure vendor defaults.
remediation: Apply an approved security baseline and disable unnecessary default features.

title: Exposed Configuration File
description: A configuration file containing sensitive information is accessible to unauthorized users.
remediation: Restrict access to configuration files and remove secrets from exposed locations.

title: Hardcoded Application Secret
description: Application source code contains credentials or sensitive secrets.
remediation: Remove embedded secrets, rotate them and store future secrets in a secure vault.

title: Insecure Environment Variables
description: Sensitive environment variables are exposed to unauthorized processes or users.
remediation: Restrict access to environment configuration and use a secrets management solution.

title: Unused Administrative Account
description: An unnecessary administrative account remains enabled.
remediation: Disable unused privileged accounts and regularly review account inventories.

title: Security Logging Misconfiguration
description: Security events are generated but are not correctly collected or retained.
remediation: Configure centralized logging with appropriate retention and monitoring policies.

title: Missing Backup Encryption
description: System backups containing sensitive information are stored without encryption.
remediation: Encrypt backup data and protect associated encryption keys.

title: Backup Restoration Not Tested
description: Backups exist but restoration procedures are not periodically validated.
remediation: Perform scheduled restoration tests and document recovery results.

title: Public Cloud Storage Bucket
description: A cloud storage resource permits unauthorized public access.
remediation: Disable public access and enforce identity-based access controls.

title: Cloud Security Group Too Permissive
description: A cloud firewall rule allows access from unrestricted network ranges.
remediation: Restrict security group rules to approved source networks and required ports.

title: Publicly Exposed Cloud Database
description: A managed cloud database is accessible directly from the public internet.
remediation: Move the database to private networking and restrict inbound connectivity.

title: Cloud Administrator Without MFA
description: A highly privileged cloud account does not require multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged cloud identities.

title: Overprivileged Cloud Identity
description: A cloud identity has permissions substantially beyond its operational requirements.
remediation: Review permissions and apply least-privilege cloud roles.

title: Cloud Access Key Not Rotated
description: A long-lived cloud access key has not been rotated according to security policy.
remediation: Rotate the key and migrate workloads to short-lived credentials where possible.

title: Secret Stored in Cloud Metadata
description: Sensitive credentials are exposed through instance or workload metadata.
remediation: Remove secrets from metadata and use the cloud provider secrets management service.

title: Cloud Audit Trail Disabled
description: Administrative cloud activity is not fully recorded for security monitoring.
remediation: Enable cloud audit logging across all regions and protected services.

title: Unencrypted Cloud Storage
description: Cloud-hosted sensitive information is stored without encryption at rest.
remediation: Enable encryption at rest and manage encryption keys securely.

title: Inactive Cloud Resource Exposed
description: An unused cloud resource remains publicly reachable and unmanaged.
remediation: Remove or isolate unused resources and include them in regular asset reviews.

title: Missing API Authentication
description: A sensitive API endpoint can be accessed without requiring authentication.
remediation: Require authentication for all sensitive API endpoints and validate credentials server-side.

title: Broken API Authorization
description: Authenticated API users can perform operations outside their assigned permissions.
remediation: Implement authorization checks for every protected API operation.

title: API Rate Limiting Missing
description: The API does not restrict excessive request volumes from individual clients.
remediation: Implement rate limiting and appropriate abuse protection on exposed API endpoints.

title: Sensitive API Data Exposure
description: An API response returns more sensitive information than required by the client.
remediation: Minimize API response data and explicitly select fields permitted for each client.

title: API Input Validation Missing
description: API input is processed without sufficient server-side validation.
remediation: Validate and sanitize all API input using strict server-side schemas.

title: API Version Exposes Legacy Endpoint
description: An obsolete API version remains accessible and contains weaker security controls.
remediation: Disable unsupported API versions and migrate clients to maintained endpoints.

title: Insecure JWT Validation
description: The application does not correctly validate all security properties of JSON Web Tokens.
remediation: Validate token signatures, expiration, issuer and permitted algorithms.

title: Long-Lived Authentication Token
description: Authentication tokens remain valid significantly longer than necessary.
remediation: Reduce token lifetime and implement a secure token renewal mechanism.

title: Session Token Exposed in URL
description: A sensitive authentication token is included in a URL and may be recorded in logs or history.
remediation: Transmit authentication tokens using secure headers or protected cookies instead of URLs.

title: Missing Logout Token Revocation
description: Authentication tokens remain usable after a user explicitly logs out.
remediation: Implement appropriate token invalidation or short-lived session mechanisms.

title: Container Running as Root
description: A production container executes its application processes with root privileges.
remediation: Configure the container to run as a dedicated non-root user.

title: Privileged Container Enabled
description: A container is granted privileged access to the underlying host.
remediation: Remove privileged mode and grant only explicitly required capabilities.

title: Container Image Uses Outdated Base
description: The deployed container image is built from an outdated base image containing known weaknesses.
remediation: Update the base image and rebuild the container using current security patches.

title: Container Image Not Scanned
description: Container images are deployed without automated vulnerability assessment.
remediation: Integrate container image vulnerability scanning into the build and deployment pipeline.

title: Container Secret Embedded in Image
description: A credential or sensitive secret is stored directly inside a container image layer.
remediation: Remove and rotate the exposed secret and inject future secrets securely at runtime.

title: Container Registry Publicly Accessible
description: A private container registry permits unauthorized public access.
remediation: Restrict registry access and require authenticated authorization for image operations.

title: Kubernetes Dashboard Exposed
description: The Kubernetes administration dashboard is reachable from an untrusted network.
remediation: Restrict dashboard access to trusted administrative networks and require strong authentication.

title: Kubernetes Excessive RBAC Permissions
description: A Kubernetes account or service account has unnecessarily broad cluster permissions.
remediation: Review RBAC assignments and apply least-privilege roles and bindings.

title: Kubernetes Secret Poorly Protected
description: Sensitive Kubernetes secrets are insufficiently protected from unauthorized access.
remediation: Restrict secret access and enable appropriate encryption and external secrets management.

title: Unrestricted Container Network Policy
description: Container workloads can communicate across network boundaries without sufficient restrictions.
remediation: Implement network policies restricting traffic between workloads to required communication only.

title: CI Pipeline Secret Exposure
description: A continuous integration pipeline exposes credentials through build output or configuration.
remediation: Remove exposed credentials, rotate them and use protected CI secret storage.

title: Untrusted Code Executed in CI
description: The build pipeline can execute code from untrusted contributions with excessive permissions.
remediation: Isolate untrusted builds and restrict access to credentials and privileged runners.

title: CI Runner Overprivileged
description: A continuous integration runner has unnecessary administrative access to infrastructure.
remediation: Reduce runner permissions and isolate build environments according to least privilege.

title: Unsigned Deployment Artifact
description: The deployment process does not verify the authenticity of application artifacts.
remediation: Sign release artifacts and verify signatures before deployment.

title: Production Deployment Without Approval
description: Production changes can be deployed without an explicit authorization step.
remediation: Require protected deployment environments and authorized approval for production releases.

title: Source Repository Secret Exposure
description: A source code repository contains a credential or sensitive secret.
remediation: Remove the secret from repository history, rotate it and enable automated secret scanning.

title: Repository Branch Protection Missing
description: Critical source branches can be modified without review or protection rules.
remediation: Enable branch protection, mandatory reviews and restricted direct pushes.

title: Dependency Update Process Missing
description: Application dependencies are not regularly reviewed or updated.
remediation: Implement automated dependency update monitoring and a regular patch management process.

title: Security Scanner Credentials Exposed
description: Credentials used by a security scanning tool are insufficiently protected.
remediation: Rotate exposed credentials and store scanner secrets using a secure secrets management service.

title: Vulnerability Scanner Coverage Gap
description: Critical assets are excluded from scheduled vulnerability assessment.
remediation: Update scanner scope to include all active and security-relevant assets.

title: SIEM Log Source Missing
description: A critical system does not forward security events to centralized monitoring.
remediation: Configure the asset to forward required security logs to the SIEM platform.

title: Security Alerts Not Monitored
description: Security alerts are generated but are not actively reviewed or routed to responsible personnel.
remediation: Configure alert ownership, escalation and monitoring procedures.

title: Log Retention Too Short
description: Security logs are retained for insufficient time to support investigations.
remediation: Increase security log retention according to organizational and regulatory requirements.

title: System Clock Not Synchronized
description: A system clock is not synchronized with an approved time source, reducing log reliability.
remediation: Configure secure and reliable time synchronization using approved NTP sources.

title: Endpoint Protection Disabled
description: Endpoint security protection is disabled on an active workstation or server.
remediation: Enable endpoint protection and prevent unauthorized users from disabling security controls.

title: Malware Definitions Outdated
description: The endpoint protection engine uses outdated malware detection signatures.
remediation: Update protection signatures automatically and monitor endpoint security health.

title: Removable Media Unrestricted
description: Users can connect unmanaged removable storage devices to sensitive systems.
remediation: Restrict removable media usage and enforce approved device policies.

title: Legacy Remote Access Service
description: An outdated remote access service remains enabled despite no longer being operationally required.
remediation: Disable the obsolete remote access service and use a supported secure alternative.

title: Security Baseline Not Applied
description: A system does not conform to the organization's approved security configuration baseline.
remediation: Apply the approved security baseline and periodically verify configuration compliance.

title: Asset Missing Security Owner
description: A critical technology asset does not have a clearly assigned security owner.
remediation: Assign ownership and responsibility for security maintenance and vulnerability remediation.
